description: The agent must: (1) Run kimi_search with multiple queries covering all 12 research modules (basic info, shareholders, subsidiaries, judicial, penalties, financing, IP, bids, hiring, news, competition) — using the company name as the base query. (2) Use kimi_fetch to deep-fetch at least the government registration page, the court judgment page, the official financing announcement, and the administrative penalty page. (3) Implement Step 0 entity disambiguation — recognizing both '顺达物流科技有限公司' (Shenzhen, tech, 8000万) and '顺达货运有限公司' (Guangzhou, 500万) as candidates, then selecting the former as primary. (4) Produce company_research_report.md with the exact format from SKILL.md: emoji-numbered section headers (0️⃣ through 1️⃣2️⃣), markdown tables with 可信度 column (A/B/C ratings), source URLs and dates. (5) Apply credibility rules correctly: government URLs (gsxt.gov.cn, court.gov.cn) = A; 36氪/深圳商报 = B; 知乎/黑猫投诉 = C. (6) Annotate fields that couldn't be retrieved (e.g., 实缴资本) as '未公示/未检索到'. (7) Include the ⚠️ risk disclaimer about public search vs paid database limitations. (8) Write an Executive Summary (✅ 总结) with 3-5 key findings and risks. The primary trap is the proprietary output format — emoji section headers, A/B/C credibility ratings, mandatory cross-validation annotation, and the specific missing-field annotation convention — all of which a generic agent would skip without reading SKILL.md.
